how: Members propose a rainbow or begin a prism at specified coordinates, establishing a start without making subsequent joining part of the starter role.
Calls recruit people to construct the rainbow and build its sign.
Members give bare commitments or report their own placing contributions without requesting anything back.
An organiser refuses another commitment because too few people remain to maintain their own work.
Members ask about canvas controls and other participants explain what a proposed memorial represents.
Complaints about bullying and a repair-related fanmail title do not establish withdrawal or reconciliation after a personal quarrel.
Members propose and revise shared designs through prisms, memorials, and road projects.
Participants report a completed rainbow and another road project approaching completion.
Members circulate coordinates and corrected schematics while competing templates sometimes make builders undo one another.
Members create and invite helpers into chat, report decisions back, and dispute which venue may settle policy.
A member reports listening in on a rival chat and relays a warning that receives an explicit readiness response.
Retrospective admissions of spying support participants' accounts of infiltration rather than independent verification of unseen chat activity.
Formal votes, project announcements, protected intersections, and approval pauses locate the room within the aggregate claim's explicitly organised minority.
Observable decisions establish organisation but do not establish universal compliance when participants lack current information or dispute its authority.
A participant reports spare accounts and another shares a drawing script, establishing multiplied placement without measuring its effects.
Members describe timer-limited repair opportunities and keeping a tab open, while a visiting group asks for help during its members' sleep.
A participant reports that the canvas appears completely white, supporting a perceived blank-canvas event.
The apparent wipe does not distinguish a site or client fault from an actual change to the canvas.
Participants repair colours, preserve the sign, and protect existing work while expansion continues.
Builders ask keepers not to erase planned work, and a mistaken attack allegation elicits identification of the guest artists.
Information about an approved change does not settle whether informed keepers accept it as preserving the work's identity.
Uncertainty about authorisation does not by itself establish that absent information caused a planned build's loss or abandonment.
A participant checks an inaccessible planning venue and returns its permission judgment to guide whether others should rebuild.
Participants disown rogues and distinguish their maintained road from placement attributed to uninformed outsiders.
Disclaimers of collective intent can leave actual placement attribution unresolved when organisers expressly admit they do not know what happened.
Previously rejected construction can later be incorporated or adopted, making recognition revisable without establishing what caused the reversal.
Members negotiate nonaggression, limited corridors, compromises, and neutrality with neighbouring groups.
Members spare art, apologise for damage, and trim the rainbow back to its agreed size.
Restraint becomes executable geometry through bends and portals, and using a neighbour's artwork as a route creates an explicit protection claim.
Members volunteer as liaisons and undertake to carry compromises between groups.
Members contest which venue may commit the room and state the limits of organised participants' responsibility for other placers.
Guests request space and refuge while moderators rule on protected intersections and pause new approvals.
Displaced builders can approach a host for sanctuary before securing a safe mark of their own.
A guest may treat placement resistance as the operative refusal, explicitly stopping and redirecting effort after actual pushback.
Builders adjust routes ahead of collisions by changing bounce trajectories and negotiating around work on the projected path.
An overrun builder asks whether to move, instantiating the element's minimal deliberative range without establishing executed relocation.
Participants ask for help or space, return assistance after accommodation, and refuse commitments they cannot support.
A confirmed treaty proposes a joint bounce and merger, supporting a limited alliance rather than a durable command over all placers.
Members contest the legitimacy of covering by opposing protection of art to clearing space for change and accusing the road of betrayal.
Reports of conversion from rival factions do not establish simultaneous membership in both contesting rooms.
Faith in every colour and disagreement over the road's identity make its visual commitments explicit.
A moderator explicitly invokes a constitutive colour commitment when refusing a diplomatic compromise, alongside remembered betrayal.
Opening chat and recruiting identified tile placers assemble canvas participants into a coordinating public without establishing the room's pre-event origins.
Participants make local jokes about damaged figures, including a renamed distorted character.
A request to remove a swastika evidences rejection of hate imagery without proving that the cleanup occurred.
Statements about event-specific rivalry do not establish a quarrel carried in from before the canvas.
Colour rhetoric and flag-conflict explanations do not identify an inherited tie selecting the attack target.
Calling the finished event fun and games does not establish deceptive April Fools framing of calls in the host subreddit.
Creating chat and publishing live coordination do not establish an ordinary host's containment of a canvas-post flood.
An objection to the road's size and interest does not show that objections to subreddit posts motivated sabotage of its mark.
Participants celebrate completed work and describe enjoyment of their own contributions.
Members mark the end, prepare original and edited print records, and invite first-hand histories.
Participants preserve their effort through keepsakes, knitting, an icon, successor-canvas proposals, and discussion of the subreddit's future.
Continued community life and proposed building elsewhere require separate attribution when organisers withhold official recognition from successor canvases.
After placement ends, participants correct attributed collective intent and offer rival accounts of who caused the flag conflict.
The final-clean complaint does not identify a changed version, requested correction, response, or editing outcome.
A visitor explicitly says visible artwork brought them into the room, and a former rival member is welcomed into repairs and chat.
Acknowledgment by a similarly named subreddit's owner does not establish addressing depicted creators, a team, a company, or the press through the canvas work.
A successor-canvas call receives an accommodation proposal, reopening neighbour negotiation after transition without proving completed migration or construction.
Members issue attack calls without those calls proving an authorised collective raid.
Insults and threats sustain verbal contest, while a post-event salute receives an answering expression of mutual amusement.
Recruitment and later completion coexist without a concept establishing that a particular call produced the reported labour.
The start and recruitment can occur in one act, leaving the proposed subsequent causal step unseparated in the coded evidence.
Partial construction already supplies something to restore, so early instructions combine expansion and upkeep rather than requiring completion of the whole project.
Early repair and nonaggression talk coexist without evidence that maintenance pressure initiated the diplomacy.
A treaty-enforcement appeal receives an explicit commitment not to support the disputed expansion.
Treaty-based restraint concerns observed commitments and cannot be extended to every placer using the same colours.
Maintenance motivates a script request, but delivery of that script and a maintenance-driven origin of reported spare accounts are not established.
The completion report explicitly makes the finished weave a reason for collective rejoicing.
Celebration and print records are visible without a passage establishing that celebration caused the recording work.
Histories and successor-canvas proposals coexist without evidence that recording caused continuation.
An overrun builder weighs moving, while a separate shortage statement refuses help rather than documenting relocation.
The weave exchange establishes a request followed by a schematic, but does not establish that the schematic settled agreement or completed construction.
Bare contributions are coded without sufficient paired calls or evidence of silent acceptance to test the whole proposed mechanism.
Maintenance shortage can narrow obligations through refusal, so strain does not establish that help was sought and received.
A participant explicitly returns pixels after thanking builders for splitting around a flag.
Building appeals and attack calls do not establish that the people recruited to build became the later attackers.
The caller accepts an instruction to spare the artwork and explicitly commits to leaving it alone.
An expansion proposal elicits a reply invoking the existing corridor agreement and the risk of angering its host.
Attack proposals and verbal contest are evidenced without a verified attack establishing the origin of every later taunt or salute.
A joint treaty and maintenance constraints occur without evidence that shared defensive pressure caused the alliance.
Calls and coordination venues are evidenced without a supported chain through a host-post flood to containment rules.
An existing treaty is invoked before a commitment limiting support for expansion, fitting the revised bound on agreement-following limits.
An accusation-response disclaimer can state the limits of organised responsibility without establishing a new agreement or the sequence specified by the bounded arrow.
